name: Ghanasham Salunkhe
bio: Backend Engineer and Data Engineer blending Java/Spring Boot microservices with practical big-data engineering on Spark and Databricks. I design systems that don’t fall apart under load, automate data pipelines end-to-end, and deploy everything on Azure with clean, maintainable architecture. My work leans toward performance, reliability, and solving real business problems rather than stacking buzzwords.

timeline.description: Working as a full-time Software Engineer with focus on backend systems, data engineering pipelines, microservices, and distributed processing using Java, Spring Boot, Apache Spark, Databricks, Kafka, and Azure.

education.institution: COEP Technological University, Pune (Former College of Engineering, Pune)
